plain: Ever since the first atomic bombs, the beings behind UFOs are said to have taken a huge interest in nuclear weapons and to have "denatured" them so they will not go off, and the last test missile Vladimir Putin tried to launch is said to have exploded in its silo. Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, meaning someone trained to describe distant places and events with the mind alone, tells Michels this as something he was told. If true, an outside power would be quietly disarming the world's nuclear arsenals.
